facts.claim: Hyderabad had a population of 7,517 according to the last census.
facts.quote: Hyderabad is according to the last census 7,517, that of the Madras Presidency is 28,900, that of the Bombay 50,800, of Rajputana and Central India 9,900, and of the Central Provinces 6,700.

facts.claim: The capital, including Secunderabad, had 3,784 men from the North‑Western Provinces and Oudh, about 1,647 from the Madras Presidency, 1,350 from Bombay, 3,603 from Rajputana and Central India, and about 200 from the Central Provinces.
facts.quote: There are in the capital including Secunderabad, 3,784 men from the united Provinces of North-Western and Oudh, 1,64-7 from the Madras Presidency, 1,350 from the Bombay, 3,603 from Rajputana and Central India, and about 200 from the Central Provinces.
